notes.source: workflow/plausible-register.json PLR-077 (disposition FIX_LANE) = SMB-REEL-RECEIPTS lane notes residual R1
decisions: D1 end of a Partial video receipt = max over delivered pictures of (meta.pts + meta.duration), the same pts + duration the packet loop uses for a non-preroll chunk (a picture carries the metadata of the packet it came from), so a complete decode would compute the identical value and a dropped last picture shortens the span; max (not the last arrival) because a decoder may release pictures out of presentation order

D2 no picture delivered -> end = actual.start_pts: the empty-span convention of this crate (isobmff deliver_packets starts delivered_end at start_actual; y4m start + 0 frames; wav and PCM cursor == start); no new convention. The result is also clamped so it is never before the start (end.max(start))

D3 only the Partial branch changes (delivered < req.count): when every picture arrived, the packet receipt is already right and is not touched, so (b) holds by construction and is also pinned by a test; an Export with a shortfall still returns Incomplete before the receipt is read

D4 picture_end() errors are the packet loop's own: overflow -> LimitExceeded tick-range, an end before presentation zero -> Unsupported negative-presentation-time; it runs after the sink accepted the picture, as the packet loop's chunk_end does after the Pump returns, and the packet loop validated the same pts + duration for every non-preroll chunk, so it adds no new failure order on any reachable input

D5 actual.start_pts is NOT changed: when the FIRST picture is dropped the span still starts at the first requested packet's pts (its start is the requested start the packets began at); the task is the end only. Noted as R1 below

D6 the new tests are added to the existing tests/video_route.rs (its Fake decoder, fixtures and request helpers), not a new file, so there is no second copy of the fake; the only change to the existing code of that file is the DropFrom plan variant and its match arm
residuals: R1 actual.start_pts of a Partial video receipt stays the pts of the first requested packet even when the decoder dropped that packet's picture (the span then starts before the first delivered picture); the lead's task named the end only, and a start that follows the first delivered picture would also need the requested-vs-actual start semantics (Approximate vs Exact disposition) decided; candidate PLR for the lead

R2 a reordering decoder that releases a picture with a later tag before earlier ones drains the earlier pending packets in Forward::accept (existing behaviour, untouched): their pictures count as dropped; not changed here
